analysis.title: NVIDIA Corporation: Lowering PT on potential CEO transition risk
key_insights: RBC lowers its NVDA price target from $330 to $230 and keeps an Outperform rating. The cut reflects a board investigation and unconfirmed media reports about CEO Jensen Huang that could lead to a change at the top.
A potential congressional hearing and national security scrutiny around export controls add a second overhang. The resolution timeline is unclear and more headlines could hurt sentiment.

RBC sees limited near-term fundamental impact: demand is outpacing supply by about 50%, the product roadmap is set for the next 3 years, and NVDA's full-stack moat plus industry-wide component tightness limits near-term competitive risk.
RBC says longer-term impact of losing Huang should not be underestimated, given his technical vision, execution record and role as the global face of AI.

NVDA has no formal CEO succession plan per the report. RBC names CFO Colette Kress, Ian Buck, Jeff Fisher, Debora Shoquist and Bill Dally as senior leaders but says it will not speculate on candidates. It expects any replacement process to take time.

China was about 1% of data center revenue last quarter (total about 8%), and the data center outlook includes no China contribution. RBC believes this limits estimate risk from export-control scrutiny.

RBC expects a strong quarter and at least a reiteration of the 70% revenue growth outlook for CY27. It cites GPU rental prices, hyperscaler capex and cloud demand (including Neoclouds) as signs of robust end-demand, even for older-generation GPUs.
Potential data center moratoriums are a material sentiment risk, but RBC says a space/power constrained environment could favor NVDA because of its tokens/watt advantage.

The new $230 target is based on 15x CY27E EPS versus about 20x before, to reflect the uncertainty. At about 10x CY27 EPS the stock trades at a roughly 60% discount to Mag7 and 70% to semi peers, which RBC calls attractive for a 6-12 month horizon.
Scenario targets: upside $400 (25x CY27E EPS, in line with AI peers) and downside $100 (6x CY27E EPS, below the 5-year trough). Implied returns are +130% and -42% from $173.73.

Cloud capex is expected to stay elevated for 12-18 months, with NVDA's $500B+ backlog cited as support. RBC estimates capex at 90%+ of hyperscaler operating cash flows and sees room for further spending.
RBC says market share should decline over time as AMD and ASIC designs ramp, but it believes this is largely priced in and expects NVDA to keep majority share.

market_movers.rationale: PT cut from $330 to $230 (15x CY27E EPS vs ~20x prior) on potential CEO transition and congressional overhang. Fundamentals are seen as intact and the stock is called cheap at ~10x CY27 EPS.

sector_views.rationale: NVDA trades at a roughly 70% discount to semi peers and a 60% discount to Mag7 at about 10x CY27 EPS, with demand outpacing supply by about 50%.

earnings_insights: RBC expects NVDA to report a strong quarter after market and at least reiterate its 70% CY27 revenue growth outlook (RBC expectation, not yet reported).
RBC adjusted diluted EPS estimates: FY27E $9.24, FY28E $15.96, FY29E $19.58 (FY26A $4.75). Quarterly: 1Q27 $1.87A, 2Q27 $2.22A, 3Q27E $2.44, 4Q27E $2.71.
RBC estimates gross margin of 74.0% in 3Q27E and 71.5% in 4Q27E, with FY27E at 73.7%. Operating margin is 65.2% for FY27E.
China was about 1% of data center revenue last quarter (total about 8%), per the company. Data center guidance excludes China.

trade_ideas.description: Long NVDA, Outperform with $230 PT (15x CY27E EPS), for a 6-12 month horizon
trade_ideas.rationale: Valuation at about 10x CY27 EPS more than reflects the fundamental risk from a potential CEO transition, while demand outpaces supply by about 50%.
trade_ideas.risk: CEO transition, congressional hearings, cloud capex cuts, share loss, supply chain bottlenecks.

tension_points.bull_case: Near-term fundamentals are intact: demand is outpacing supply by about 50%, the roadmap is set for 3 years, and at about 10x CY27 EPS the stock reflects the CEO risk.
tension_points.bear_case: Huang's vision and execution have been central to NVDA's dominance, there is no formal succession plan, and hearings plus export scrutiny could add headline pressure.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Replacement of the current CEO with a longer than expected transition period (RBC's $100 downside scenario).

theme_stances.key_argument: A potential CEO change creates uncertainty, but limited near-term fundamental impact and a low valuation keep RBC at Outperform.
theme_stances.evidence: more than reflecting the fundamental risks from a potential CEO transition
